site.name: Blue Grouse Mine
overview: Blue Grouse Mine is a documented historic mine in Gilpin County's Independence (Perigo) Mining District.
Mineral records identify the property as a past-producing gold mine, with zinc, lead, copper and silver also recorded at the locality.
moreHistory: Mine-location records place Blue Grouse near 39.88583, -105.54583. A legal description for the Blue Grouse claim places the property in Section 10, Township 2 South, Range 73 West in Gilpin County.
The mapped locality identifies the historic mine property; no claim is made that a surviving portal, shaft, or other opening has been field-verified or is accessible today.
A focused exact-site media search did not locate a defensible reusable historic photograph, so unrelated district imagery was not attached.
